edits.new:
Then the response is status 403 with MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC13 An unauthenticated call to a provided operation is answered 401 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given no valid credential is presented
    When a caller sends GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/RC-2026-000123/timers
    Then the response is status 401
    Then no timer row is returned

  Scenario: AC14 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the case unchanged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-comms contract mock fails or does not answer within 2 s
    When "LIT-0101" opens case "RC-2026-000123"
    Then the case answer still returns noticePeriod with no change to its values
    Then the case status stays "IN_PROGRESS"
    Then no NOTICE_PERIOD timer is written or changed by the failed call

  Scenario: AC15 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given case "RC-2026-000123" is "IN_PROGRESS"
    When a status change that the case model does not allow is requested for "RC-2026-000123"
    Then the change is refused and the case status stays "IN_PROGRESS"
    Then no case status event is published
